calibration.heldout_status: These heldout flights were previously inspected during model development; fresh native flights are the prospective test.

frozen_protocol.excluded_from_calibration: Native pose/velocity/attitude/actuator reports and fused translation estimates. Training corpus came from older pilot excitation; only the whitelisted public observation fields entered the fit.

architecture_score.scope: Retrospective native scoring only. No labels returned to the pilot. Camera timestamps retain their alignment uncertainty.
architecture_score.association_rule: Retrospective3D map consistency, not a pixel identity oracle. Nominal-size PnP plus scored native pose chooses nearest map center within max(3m,15%range) and >3m separation from second. Pose/depth error can mimic a wrong landmark. Others unknown.

specific_failure.bug: Final approach used forward range without checking transverse crossing position. The estimate already predicted a miss.
specific_failure.change: Optional crossing constraint brakes and aligns before blind entry. Constant-velocity forecast up to2s,0.55m centerline bound,0.25m position/0.3m/s settling. Plane is the pilot approach direction; it is not a posterior probability.
specific_failure.remaining_failure: Constrained trial02 stopped at native/estimated gate3 after usable-image age exceeded2s. No contact. Velocity and attitude drift during braking remain unsolved.

limits: Three-run cohorts are small and have independent timing/noise; these are not paired identical sensor inputs.
No joint posterior covariance or full dynamics replay after delayed attitude correction.
No timed perception-aware path optimizer. Current5m/s cap alone implies roughly32s for160m before stops.
True image exposure-to-actuation delay and actual IMU physics integration interval are unknown.
Native-coordinate origin and absolute yaw are gauge choices; one fixed scorer alignment, no scale fit.
Nominal1.5m aperture and camera calibration are priors. Body clearance is uncalibrated.
3D map-consistency scores can confuse pose/depth error with identity error; they are not a pixel identity oracle.
